outcome_description: discard rate x 100: unrecovered kidneys / (unrecovered + wasted + transplanted) at the two airports
notes: Origin-destination airport-pair x year panel 2002-2017, balanced. pair_id = integer code of OrgDestAirport (unit FE and cluster, as vce(cl OrgDestAirport)). gyear = EventYear for treated pairs (treatment_pair==1), NA for never-treated control pairs; D = 1[year >= gyear] equals the authors' TreatmentAfter on every row (checked). Treatment is absorbing (no switch-offs). The 2002 cohort is treated in the first panel year (always-treated): kept in TWFE/BJS samples as in the authors' regression; did::att_gt drops it. UnrecoveredRate100 = 100 x UnrecoveredRate (Table 5 note: outcomes multiplied by 100); standardized estimates are unaffected. Authors' line 312: reg UnrecoveredRate TreatmentAfter TxYear* ODPair* if airport_dist >= 800, vce(cl OrgDestAirport). fixest: -0.6975662 (0.2799118 Stata dof), N 8,784, adj. R2 0.2861; published -0.698 (0.280), N 8,784, adj. R2 0.286. Abstract mentions the result qualitatively ('a decrease in the organ discard rate'). Expected run_spec TWFE = -0.6975662 / 3.9521118 = -0.17650.
